firstMismatch.source: FOUNTAIN is excluded by the JavaScript ordinary-drop preflight, so C's ordinary placement path never runs.

summary: At the fountain square, the recorded drop command reaches do.c:dropx -> dropy -> dropz -> flooreffects. In C, FOUNTAIN is not a pool, lava, trap, or another special flooreffects arm; the ordinary object remains and is placed. JavaScript's preflight_dropx rejects this dry terrain at its explicit ordinary-terrain allowlist before any drop state transition. The saved accepted comparison uses 93fa87a40ed6219b5d31e211f22b460af55bfe92; the claimed task base has identical js/, frozen/, and package.json inputs, so the cause remains current.

source.branch: An ordinary, non-boulder item is dropped onto a FOUNTAIN. C's dropx extracts it, does not ship it at this location, then dropz calls flooreffects; FOUNTAIN is distinct from POOL/LAVA and does not satisfy a special destructive/effect branch, so placement continues. The JS preflight rejects the terrain before that path.
callers: cmd.c:rhack dispatches the drop command to doddrop(); do.c:doddrop calls drop()/menu_drop(), which passes the chosen object to drop().
do.c:drop calls dropx() for a floor-reachable ordinary drop; do.c:dropx frees inventory, attempts shipping/altar handling and then calls dropy().
do.c:dropy calls dropz(); do.c:dropz calls flooreffects(), then places and stacks the object when no special effect consumes it.

evidence: C source nethack-c/upstream/src/do.c:162-362: flooreffects() has boulder-pool, boulder-pit/hole, lava, pool, hero pit-edge/shaft, glob, monster-altar, and hot ROOM/CORR potion branches; there is no fountain branch. A non-special dry landing returns false and permits placement.
C source nethack-c/upstream/src/do.c:786-796 and 800-843: dropx -> dropy -> dropz orders inventory removal, shipping/altar handling, floor effects and ordinary placement.
C source nethack-c/upstream/include/rm.h:84, 127-132: FOUNTAIN=28 and IS_POOL is the POOL..DRAWBRIDGE_UP range; POOL follows FOUNTAIN in the enum, so a fountain is excluded from is_pool().

JavaScript source js/do.js:1983-1999: preflight_dropx's dry-terrain admission allowlist accepts ROOM, CORR, DOOR, SINK, THRONE, ALTAR and stairway locations, but omits FOUNTAIN and throws UnsupportedDropError before the already-ported drop tail executes.
